A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable 48-page versions of the same PRMBench paper, including Appendices A–F. Full-text comparison and rendered-page inspection support comparison of their text, equations, tables, and figures without material gaps.

before.justification: v4 reports original evaluations of 25 models and human performance in Table 3, STEM-domain experiments in Tables 10–12, and Best-of-8 experiments in Tables 13–14.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including the model and human evaluations, STEM experiments, and appendix Best-of-8 comparisons.

M1.justification: The data-curation pipeline, error-generation procedures, filtering, and PRM/critic evaluation procedures are unchanged. The reformatted appendix prompts contain the same instructions.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same PRMBench categories, physics/chemistry/biology extension, and GSM8K, MATH, Olympiad Bench, and MMLU coverage for Best-of-8 evaluation.

E2.justification: Each corresponding experiment retains its comparator set, including the main evaluation, individual STEM subsets, and Best-of-8 comparisons (Tables 3 and 10–14). No evaluated comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: The metrics, two-shot critic prompting, 394-sample o1-mini/DeepSeek-R1 subset, 450-instance human evaluation, and Best-of-8 sampling procedures remain unchanged (Section 4; Appendices A.3.2 and C.2).

E4.justification: The inference-bias, error-position, few-shot, and Best-of-8 analyses in Section 5 and the error case study in Appendix C.1 retain identical evidence. Resizing appendix examples adds no analysis.

E5.justification: Figure 4 retains the same error bars, and Tables 6, 13, and 14 retain their statistical summaries. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All corresponding result entries and plotted findings are unchanged, including Table 3's scores of 68.8 for Gemini-2.0-thinking-exp-1219 and 83.8 for humans. The STEM, Best-of-8, and detailed appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The category definitions, PRMScore equation (1), and similarity formula in Section 5.1 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, proofs, or counterexamples are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same benchmark scope, claims about PRM weaknesses, and PRMEval toolkit contribution.

C2.justification: The interpretations in Section 5, limitations in Section 8, and future research directions in Appendix F are identical. The limitations text only reflows after the expanded acknowledgement.

D1.justification: Data-construction and evaluation details, annotator instructions, prompt contents, and project/code/data access information remain unchanged. The appendix formatting changes introduce no new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works and related-work positioning are unchanged. The new acknowledgement to Zhiyi Li does not add a cited work or revise the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: Section 7 slightly rewrites the institutional acknowledgement and adds thanks to Zhiyi Li at HKUST for examples and inspiration. The arXiv version/date stamp updates; scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v5 resizes and repositions appendix Figures 17–24, changes some borders, and removes printed page numbers from PDF pages 17 and 20–48. Page 9 reflows around the longer acknowledgement. Figure and table contents and captions are retained.

improvement.justification: v5 adds contributor credit in Section 7 and makes modest layout adjustments, while retaining the complete scientific content and evidence. The appendix content remains readable and intact; these editorial changes do not meaningfully alter the paper's clarity, rigor, or reproducibility.
